title: Not as strong as many
text: Not as strong as many. I was a little disappointed in these. The scent was not as strong as many I have bought and they haven't lasted that long. I have tried to "re-scent" these kinds of things with no success. Adding oils etc just leaves oil on the floor. I gave it up.
